# Documentation

Inspect implemented code, configuration, and existing docs before writing. Edit documentation files only; if code or generated API artifacts need a change, return that request to Engineering. Update README, setup, architecture, ADR, API, deployment, runbook, configuration, or troubleshooting guidance when behavior requires it. Explain why, constraints, interfaces, operations, and recovery; skip obvious line-by-line narration. Avoid duplicate explanations. Describe implemented reality, not an obsolete proposal. Verify local links, commands, and claims; report anything not confirmed.
